patch_resolves_note: The staged fix changes the fuzz-only span setup from `len` to `len - 1`; the fixed original still reaches `multiline_probe`, but does so with `lexer_end` one byte before `(char *)data + len`, so the parser exits cleanly before the out-of-bounds re-entry.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled fuzz buffer into parser state. `config_init_data()` binds the lexer cursor to the copied bytes in `static_data`, creating the exact span later consumed by the multiline-string scanner.

The lexer extent is materialized from the full copied length `len = 32768`, so `lexer->end` becomes `static_data + 32768`. For this witness that leaves no reserved byte between the parser's logical span and the ASan redzone, allowing the multiline-string loop to re-enter with `lexer->pos` already at the first byte past the array.

ASan crash site. After the loop condition has advanced `lexer->pos` to `static_data + 32768`, `strncmp` reads from the first byte past the 32,768-byte global `static_data` array while probing for a closing triple-quote delimiter.
Intermediate runtime event fuzz_span_ready materialized from verified transition assertion A-END-BOUND-CARRIES-TO-MULTILINE-PROBE.
Intermediate runtime event loop_condition_advance materialized from verified transition assertion A-NEXT-ADVANCED-CURSOR-REACHES-MULTILINE-PROBE.

edges.description: The exclusive parser bound materialized for the fuzzing span is carried unchanged into the later multiline-string probe as `lexer->end`.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable frozen trace shows `fuzz_span_ready.lexer_end == multiline_probe.lexer_end == 0x114d4a0`; fixed original likewise preserves the bound (`0x114d49f`).

edges.description: The cursor value written back to `lexer->pos` by `next(lexer)` in the loop condition is the same pointer used as the first `strncmp` argument on the following multiline-string probe.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable frozen trace shows `loop_condition_advance.pos_after_next == multiline_probe.strncmp_pos == 0x114d4a0`; fixed original shows the same carry at the safe boundary (`0x114d49f`).
